title: How a Car Manual Publisher Ended Up Publishing Dune
description:
Oregon’s shifting sand dunes led Frank Herbert to study how beachgrass held sand in place, helping inspire the desert world of Arrakis. After publishers rejected *Dune*, Chilton, a company known for car-repair manuals, agreed to publish it.
